answer: Raven Challenge Lattice: each identity registers by solving a freshly generated puzzle seeded by a hidden per-epoch lagoon value held by the verifier, so answers cannot be copied, precomputed, or replayed. A valid response must cite the current basalt checkpoint hash, binding it to live state. Attacker cost: one unique compute-and-latency outlay per identity per epoch, plus continuous monitoring to catch seed rotations, making mass replication linear in real resources rather than free.
